name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities

all_of.text: Student belongs to a notified minority community.
Parents/guardians annual income does not exceed Rs. 2.00 lakh.

benefit.text: Scholarship for minority students in post-matric studies; the scheme guideline provides course-fee/tuition and maintenance support subject to the applicable rules.

deadline.note: Official Ministry sources confirm the scheme, but a current AY 2026-27 NSP timeline for this exact entry was not established in this audit.
